title: pilosella × bifurca subsp. pachyclada

This plant is known to exhibit potential health benefits, such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and reduce the risk of chronic diseases. The therapeutic actions of Pilosella × bifurca subsp. pachyclada include its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial properties, making it a potential candidate for the treatment of various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
